context: Daichi and Kenji after work. Daichi reflects on impending fatherhood.
purpose: two working men talking about life beyond work

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: だいちさん、お父さんになるんですね。改めて、おめでとう。
lines.en: Daichi-san, you're going to be a father. Congratulations—really.
lines.style: Warm, measured delivery. Opens with gentle weight on the congratulation. Soft, genuine tone throughout—this is a moment that matters. No rush. A man speaking to a friend about something real.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。正直、責任、重く感じてます。
lines.en: Thank you. To be honest, I feel the weight of it—the responsibility.
lines.style: Kansai lilt threading through. Drops into vulnerability mid-sentence. Slower on 'responsibility'—letting the word sit. Soft but grounded. A man admitting what scares him to someone he trusts.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: うん、わかる。私も、なる時、同じだった。
lines.en: Yeah, I get it. I felt the same way when it happened to me.
lines.style: Quiet recognition. No performance. Leans in slightly with his voice—matching Daichi's vulnerability without commentary. Warm and steady, like he's handing back what he received.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: けんじさんに、いろいろ、聞かせてもらえたら、嬉しい。
lines.en: I'd really appreciate it if you could let me ask you about things. Various things.
lines.style: Respectful, almost careful. The Kansai warmth softens the request so it doesn't sound like asking for help—it sounds like wanting connection. A little hesitant, genuine.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: もちろん。いつでも、頼ってください。
lines.en: Of course. Lean on me whenever you need to. I mean it.
lines.style: Open, unhurried. No fanfare. Just generous and available. The kind of promise that's bigger because it's understated. Warm but grounded.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 家族、ちゃんと、守っていきたい。
lines.en: I want to protect my family properly. Keep them safe.
lines.style: Kansai warmth deepens into something tender and committed. Slower pace on the closing words. There's weight here—this is a vow, said quiet and serious. Not to the room. To himself, and to Kenji.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 達也さんなら、絶対、いい父親になりますよ。
lines.en: With you, Daichi-san—you'll absolutely be a good father.
lines.style: Firm conviction sits under warm delivery. Says it like he means it, like he's seen something in Daichi worth believing in. Closes the moment gently. A real compliment, not comfort.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: I'm truly grateful. For all of it.
lines.style: Kansai lilt softens the words. Brief, genuine. No extra explanation needed. Daichi's saying thank you because he means it. Quiet close.
